import base64
import datetime

import re

OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

def parse_objects(data: bytes):
    """Return {obj_num: {'body': bytes, 'stream': bytes|None}}."""

    pat = re.compile(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+obj\b(.*?)endobj", re.S)
    for m in pat.finditer(data):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        body = m.group(2)

        if b"stream" in body:
            idx = body.find(b"stream")
            head = body[:idx]
            rest = body[idx + len(b"stream"):]
            rest = re.sub(rb"^\r?\n", b"", rest)
            end_idx = rest.rfind(b"endstream")
            if end_idx == -1:
                raise ValueError(f"unterminated stream in object {num}")
            stream_data = rest[:end_idx]
            body = head
        objs[num] = {"body": body, "stream": stream_data}
    return objs


def rewrite_refs(body: bytes, mapping: dict):
    def repl(m):
        old = int(m.group(1))
        new = mapping.get(old, old)
        return f"{new} 0 R".encode()
    return re.sub(rb"\b(\d+)\s+0\s+R\b", repl, body)

    ops.append("%.2f %.2f Td" % (date_x, date_y))
    ops.append("(%s) Tj" % esc_pdf_string(date_str))
    ops.append("ET")

        if old == 4:  # original page: point Parent at the new pages tree
            body = re.sub(rb"/Parent\s+\d+\s+0\s+R", b"/Parent 6 0 R", body)
        if obj["stream"] is not None:
            objects[new] = stream_obj(obj["stream"], body)
        else:
            objects[new] = body

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ write out

    out = bytearray()
    out += b"%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode()
        out += objects[num]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    max_num = max(offsets)
    out += b"xref\n"
    out += f"0 {max_num + 1}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, max_num + 1):
        if num in offsets:
            out += f"{offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    out += (f"<< /Size {max_num + 1} /Root 4 0 R /Info 5 0 R >>\n"
            f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n").encode()

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(out)
    print(f"Wrote {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ validate

    # 1) Reparse the merged file and verify xref offsets.
    merged = parse_objects(bytes(out))
    for num, off in offsets.items():
        if int(out[off:off + 10]) != num or out[off + 11:off + 16] != b"00000":

    assert "/Count 2" in pages_body and "/Kids [ 3 0 R 11 0 R ]" in pages_body, pages_body
    # 3) Original page 1 content must survive byte-identical (after decode).

        cbody = objs[int(m.group(1))]["body"]
        filters = re.findall(rb"/\w+", cbody)
        data = objs[int(m.group(1))]["stream"]
        if b"ASCII85Decode" in filters:
            data = base64.a85decode(data)
        if b"FlateDecode" in filters:
            data = zlib.decompress(data)
        return data

    assert "Annual Financial Report" in cover_text and date_str in cover_text
    print("Cover stream contains title and date:", date_str)
    print("VALIDATION OK")

    main()
